limitations: software processing is not physical actuator execution
independent IQ sample origins are not subtracted
DMA completion is a transmit proxy, not measured RF airtime

ble.scope: own IQ packet start to decoder availability; block quantized, not host processing or cross-device completion latency

waveform_cost.scope: All slots including sync-only, repeats and failed DMA completions; successful DMA start allocates full waveform. Failed submissions listed separately; actual emitted fraction unknown. Padding is zero IQ, not proof of zero RF energy.
